props.note: Game addition: a cold-water coral mound with thickets and sponges on the canyon's coral-habitat ledge (Hudson Canyon hosts deep-sea coral habitat, NOAA). No published colony position exists, so the placement and layout are invented.
Game addition: a bedded canyon-wall ledge beyond the coral mound, so the flank has a visible rim. Hudson Canyon's walls are steep; this ledge's size and placement are invented.
